figures_reviewed.notes: Panel A clearly separates HARPS (blue circles) and VLT ESPRESSO (red squares) exoplanet hosts and non-planet controls across inverted Teff (6250-3500 K) and [M/H] (-1.45 to +0.50 dex); Panel B displays all 26 star empirical 12-line NIST RV minus Gaia DR3 RV offsets within <=0.76 km/s with crisp non-overlapping y-tick labels.

Panel A log-scale waterfall cleanly labels 422 (Legacy V2) -> 545 (V3.0 Pre-F1 G1) -> 404 (V3.1 G1_F1) -> 330 (G2) -> 234 (G3_F1) -> 209 (G4) -> 34 (G5_F2); Panel B compares per-exposure candidate counts across continuum SNR 90-445 on HARPS and ESPRESSO without clipping or text collisions.

Panel A shows HARPS and ESPRESSO Channel T (1-epoch) and Channel P (5-epoch + F1) completeness curves across 4-20 sigma (1,530 trials); Panel B demonstrates 97.1% synthetic fiber laser acceptance vs 100.0% rejection of single-pixel/single-slice spikes and oblique grazing cosmic tracks across 204 2D detector trials.

Panel A maps orbital phase phi in [0, 1) across 110 science exposures (25 near inferior conjunction, 18 near superior conjunction); Panel B plots 8-sigma 10 m beamed CW laser upper limits from 0.91 kW (HIP70849 at 24.1 pc annotated cleanly) up to ~110 kW across d = 3.64-44.86 pc.
